newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate ends lower on primary cut hopes.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate ends lower on primary cut hopes.

text.p: Mexican same-day Cetes closed 130 basis points lower on Tuesday due to demand fueled by expectations that primary rates would fall at auction this evening, traders said.
"Inflation figures (released Monday afternoon) were good and pave the way for rates to begin falling again, so investors wanted to cash in on current levels," a trader said.
Traders said that demand was from both local and foreign investors, which helped the peso fend off the adverse effects of higher yields in the U.S. bond market.
